title_sq: SHITET, APARTAMENT 2+1+2 NE LAPRAKE, RRUGA DRITAN HOXHA
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1+2 per shitje ne Rrugen Dritan Hoxha, Laprake ,Kompleksi "AKSES TIRANA"!
Siperfaqe 117.5 m2, apartamenti organizohet ne 1 koridor shperndares, 1 sallon se bashku me kuzhinen, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkon. Pozicionohet ne katin e 3 te banimit te nje pallati te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese sa me komode!
Orientimi i apartamentit: Lindje-Perendim.
Ne cmim eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi.
title_en: FOR SALE, APARTMENT 2+1+2 IN LAPRAKE, RUGA DRITAN HOXHA
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Dritan Hoxha Street, Laprake, Complex "ACCESS TIRANA"! Surface 117.5 m2, the apartment is organized in 1 distribution corridor, 1 living room together with the kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 toilets and 2 balconies. It is located on the 3rd floor of a new residential building with an elevator. The apartment is fully invested. The area in which it is located offers all the facilities for a comfortable life! Orientation of the apartment: East-West. A parking post is included in the price.
